node.statement: Fix an EXT-CB datum with e=delta+epsilon small. Let D_r be the diagonal commutative C*-subalgebra of M_r with projection basis Pi_a=E_aa, put R_a=v(Pi_a), let v_D=v restricted to D_r, and let w:C->A be w(lambda)=lambda Q. The registered definitions imply, with one universal accuracy constant independent of r, that v_D and w are sufficiently accurate non-unital inclusions, that v_D(I)=v(I_r), and that w(1)=Q; moreover Q is one-dimensional because dim S_Q=1 in the datum.
